name: Reverse route without turns: the route points in reverse order, Begin and End at the new ends, a point of interest stays at its place, the name gets ' reversed', one Undo step, no road data downloaded

name: Reversing again gives back the original route and name (the text exactly); Undo twice returns the original, Redo the reversed
eval: await __R.reverse(); const back = gpx.text === __R.orig; await __R.reverse(); const rev = gpx.text; btnUndo.click(); await __R.wait(50); const undo1 = gpx.text === __R.orig; btnUndo.click(); await __R.wait(50); btnRedo.click(); await __R.wait(50); return { back, undo1, redo: gpx.text === __R.orig, redo2: (btnRedo.click(), await __R.wait(50), gpx.text === rev), name: __R.name() === __R.origName + ' reversed' }
